engineering_question: Can a fixed composite registered-kernel trial on each leg and its four connected shafts sharpen the remaining normal-bearing bounds without changing the continuous model, its original loads or certified gap?
limits: Same fixed-reference invariant core, original six loads, all unchanged laws and positive unmeasured coefficients as the frozen continuous-normal result.

The exact registered own-leg vertical direction is in the certified core kernel. The complete continuous pressure bed derivative vanishes because neither owner is this leg; no centroid-to-area approximation is used.
Use the exact equilibrium identity D*r=p with multiplier -1, retaining the own applied-load offset. No optimized projection, inverse, factorization or response is computed.

For every attained equilibrium the signed scalar enclosure follows from the same full primal/dual gap and unchanged bearing metric. A nonpositive signed lower is inconclusive; normals remain nonnegative by law.
A positive model leg normal does not establish physical friction, contact or stiffness applicability, finite-motion demand, bracing or complete resistance.
Preserve current geometry/hardware, rejected proposal history, deferred panel/screw exceedances, excluded actual build fit and blank observations.

Retain every exact nonzero transformed coefficient, including the two -2^-55 floor remainders per leg, with its own unchanged-law stiffness. The signed offset is the exact registered load component, not asserted literal leg selfweight.
The fractions 3/4 and 1/8 select an auxiliary proof candidate only. They are not physical force-sharing ratios, stiffness values, material hypotheses or a claim of optimality.

Build each shaft direction from authenticated registered global translations and retained Y rotation, using the manifest rigid reference and its exact rotation/1000 scale. Do not impose the ideal geometric profile on actual nodal coordinates.

Every chosen leg and shaft must be excluded from every complete continuous-bed owner pair. Retain every nonzero source bearing, capture and floor coefficient and its own unchanged-law metric; compute the exact offset from all virtual-owner registered load components.

This is pure algebra on saved operators and existing exact load/gap certificates: no response, LP, inverse, factorization, contact equilibrium, CAD/native solve or model/geometry change. Physical stiffness/contact/restraint and complete resistance remain separate.
